attributes.board_name: Kentucky Board of Examiners of Psychology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved, offered or sponsored by state chapters of APA, AMA, American Psychiatric Association or NASW; recognized psychological associations; state/provincial psychology boards; graduate courses in psychology/psychiatry; Board-approved sponsors or programs; teaching max 9 h
rules.audit_note: Random audit of at least 10% of credential holders; keep certificates or use a Board-approved registry.

topics.who: Health service provider psychologists who supervise applicants, certified psychologists or LPAs

rules.notes: Applies to all credential holders. Ethics hours may be ethical practice or risk management; cultural hours = social and cultural factors affecting health. Suicide assessment, treatment and management: 6 h in the first year of licensure, then every 6 years (exemptions in the rule). 1 h = 55 min.
rules.rule_quote: (1) Each credential holder shall document the completion of at least thirty-nine (39) continuing education hours approved by the board pursuant to this administrative regulation within each three (3) year renewal period.
